settings.heading: Returns & Refunds
settings.body:
We want you to be delighted with your Karim Jewellers purchase.

30-Day Returns

Unworn items in their original packaging may be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund.

How to Return an Item

Please contact our customer care team via the Contact Us page to begin a return.

Refunds

Once your return is received and inspected, refunds are processed back to your original payment method.

This is placeholder returns information for development purposes. Replace with Karim Jewellers' confirmed returns policy before launch.
